[=SPO Cheat Sheet=]

[*Scope:*] Quick reminder for the current surface syntax accepted by [.txt|mTokenizer.] and [.txt|mSPO_Parser.].
For the source-backed walkthrough, open [<../doc_ai/10_language/11_surface_language.wiki|doc_ai/10_language/11_surface_language.wiki>].

[=Legend=]
- [.txt|§.] keyword prefix
- [.txt|€.] type annotation
- [.txt|#.] prefix/tag constructor
- [.txt|=>.] lambda body
- [.txt|<=>.] generic-lambda marker
- [.txt|..] method-call statement terminator
- [.txt|§>.] / [.txt|§<.] pipe sugar

[=Literals=]
[.spo
|()
|§TRUE
|§FALSE
|123
|-3
|§a
|"abc"
|"
||first line
||second line
|"
|_
.]

[=Data Forms=]
[.spo
|#Box 12
|(a; b)
|(a, b, c)
|{ Name: "Ada", Age: 42 }
.]

[=Patterns=]
[.spo
|x
|§DEF x
|§VAR x
|_
|#Box _
|(a; b)
|(a, b, c)
|{ Name: §DEF name }
|(x & x .> 0)
|(x € MyType)
.]

[=Types=]
[.spo
|[]
|§BOOL
|§INT
|§CHAR
|§TEXT
|§ANY
|§TYPE
|[T; U]
|[T, U, V]
|[#Tag T]
|[§VAR T]
|[T | U | V]
|[Arg => Res]
|[Obj : Arg => Res]
|[§RECURSIVE T Body]
|[§GENERIC T Body]
|[§INTERFACE T Body]
|[.tList §INT]
.]

[=Commands=]
[.spo
|§DEF Answer = 42
|§DEF Named € §INT = 7
|Pattern = Expression
|
|§VAR x := 1 .
|§VAR y:
|    = 3
|    + 4
|.
|x := 2 .
|
|§RETURN expr
|§RETURN expr IF cond
|
|§RECURSIVE {
|    §DEF Fib = (
|        §DEF n € §INT
|    ) => ...
|}
.]

[=Blocks=]
[.spo
|{
|    §RETURN 1 IF cond
|    §RETURN 0
|}
.]

- blocks are expressions
- there is no implicit "last expression wins"; use [.txt|§RETURN.]

[=Calls Lambdas and Methods=]
[.spo
|2 .+ 5
|3 .<= 5 <= 7
|a .Ord
|
|(x € §INT) => x .* x
|(§DEF t € §TYPE) <=> (
|    §DEF x € t
|) => x
|
|§DEF +... = (
|    §VAR X € §INT
|) : (
|    §DEF Y € §INT
|) {
|    X := ((§TO_VAL X) .+ Y).
|}
.]

[=Modules and Pipes=]
[.spo
|§IMPORT {
|    Std: {
|        ...+...: §DEF ...+... € [[§INT, §INT] => §INT]
|    }
|}
|
|(() .Append 1 §> .Append 2 §> .Append 3)
|.Push 3 To §<.Push 2 To §<.Push 1 To ()
|
|§EXPORT {
|    ...+...: ...+...
|}
|// or: §EXPORT Expression
.]

[=Notes=]
- [.txt|§IMPORT.] is a pattern, not just a name list.
- [.txt|§IS.] is surface sugar over [.txt|§IF value MATCH { ... }.].
- surface type keywords and IL type keywords differ: [.txt|§RECURSIVE/§GENERIC/§INTERFACE.] become [.txt|§REC/§ALL/§ANY.] in [.txt|.ILT.].
- [.txt|§INTERFACE.] is parser-visible, but broader end-to-end support is still incomplete. Use [<../doc_ai/40_verification/42_known_limits_and_extension_points.wiki|42_known_limits_and_extension_points.wiki>] for the current gap map.
